parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 6.29 m – 37.25 m
Recommendation: The high-resistivity layer (ρ≈1810 Ω·m) between approximately 6.3 m and 37.3 m depth represents the primary aquifer zone at this station; drilling should target this interval, with screen placement optimized within its thickest, most resistive portion, while confirming lithology via cuttings to rule out dry, coarse clastic material before final casing design.
